speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my clinic. I see you are here regarding a rash and some recent health changes; to help you, I need to start with a few questions. How long have you had the rash, and has it changed in appearance or spread? Have you experienced any fever, joint pain, or fatigue alongside the skin issues?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) with possible lung involvement.

Based on your recent onset of arthritis, cough, and this new rash, I need to evaluate your immune system function. REQUEST TEST: CBC, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, ANA, Anti-dsDNA, Anti-Smith, and C-Reactive Protein.
